summary: A quadrilateral revolved 270 degrees about an oblique axis 0.33 mm from one corner, one edge perpendicular to the axis to within 7e-12 rad. In SolidCraft the result changed with the first solid's operation (join or new); the kernel operation is the same revolve.

cases.name: revolve_quad_oblique_axis_near_corner_270
cases.note: A quadrilateral revolved 270 degrees about an oblique axis passing 0.33 mm from one corner; one edge is perpendicular to the axis to within 7e-12 rad. Every vertex is on one side of the axis (distances 0.332, 0.641, 20.071, 19.764 mm), so Pappus applies. Area: lateral faces by Pappus per edge (three cones and one plane) plus two caps: 5801.97451127. Faces: 6 geometric faces (3 cones, 1 plane from the edge perpendicular to the axis, 2 caps); a kernel may split at a seam. In SolidCraft the result changed with the operation of the first solid (join or new); the kernel operation is the same revolve.

volume.formula: Pappus, from the typed coordinates: area 567.477947281, centroid 10.190502456 from the axis, volume = area x distance x 3 pi/2 = 27251.2055081.
